title: Sapling Now Craftable
description: Sapling Now Craftable — a mod that adds the ability to craft saplings and mushrooms directly from leaves and blocks.
body:
### Sapling Now Craftable

Sapling Now Craftable  - is a mod that adds the ability to craft saplings and mushrooms directly from leaves and blocks. No more waiting for random drops — now you decide which trees and mushrooms to grow!  

### Main Features  
Craft saplings from leaves:  
-🌳Oak  
-🌳Dark Oak  
-🌳Birch  
-🌴Jungle  
-🍒Cherry  
-🌱Mangrove  
-🪴Acacia  
-☘️Azalea (regular and flowering)  

Craft mushrooms:  
-🍄‍🟫Brown Mushroom (giant mushroom block)  
-🍄Red Mushroom  
-🍄🍄‍🟫Nether Mushrooms (Crimson and Warped)  

### How It Works  
- Collect leaves or mushroom blocks of the desired type.  
- Place them on the crafting table according to the recipe shown in the image.  
- Receive the corresponding sapling or mushroom.  

### Why It’s Useful  
- Easy access to rare saplings and mushrooms.  
- Saves time when building and landscaping.  
- Helpful for servers and modpacks where resource balance matters.
